attributes.name: Flaming Longsword +3
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d8+3; you may additionally discard this card to add another 2d6 and the Fire trait. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. 

When another character at your location attempts a combat check, recharge this card to add 1d8+1 and the Fire trait.
